core_obligations: Fix m. Let \mathfrak q \in T. By Lemmas \reflemma-bootstrap-inherited and \reflemma-algebraize-local-cohomology-bis we see that H^i_\mathfrak q(M_\mathfrak q) \longrightarrow \lim H^i_\mathfrak q(M_\mathfrak q/I^nM_\mathfrak q) is an isomor
Suppose we can show that m'(m, \mathfrak q) can be chosen independently of \mathfrak q \in T.
Let \omega_A^\bullet be a dualizing complex. Let \delta : \Spec(A) \to \mathbfZ be the corresponding dimension function.
Pick \mathfrak q \in T with \delta(\mathfrak q) = d. Consider the ext modules E(n, j) = \textExt^j_A(I^nM, \omega_A^\bullet) A key feature we will use is that these are finite A-modules.

For i = s + 1 corresponding to j = - d - s - 1 we obtain from local duality and the results of the first paragraph that K_k, \mathfrak q = \Ker(E(m, -d - s - 1)_\mathfrak q \to E(k, -d - s - 1)_\mathfrak q) is independent of k \geq m'(m, \m
Any subset, in particular T_d = \\mathfrak q \in T \text with \delta(\mathfrak q) = d\, of the Noetherian topological space \Spec(A) with the endowed topology is Noetherian and hence quasi-compact.

difficulty_reason: H2: In the complete original Situation-bootstrap, prove pro-zero for {H_T^i(I^nM)} for i≤s and the stated eventual image-injectivity in degree s+1. The author first obtains pointwise thresholds via local cohomology comparison and Mittag-Leffler systems, then uses local duality to encode them by finite Ext modules E(n,j), stabilizes increasing kernels, spreads vanishing and surjectivity to neighbourhoods, and uses quasi-compact dimension-function strata with finitely many delta values to make thresholds uniform over q∈T. This actual pointwise-to-uniform construction is the counted core. Original hypotheses, m0/m′ quantifiers and author-omitted details are retained; no new completeness or regularity assumption is added.
